title: AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Bogotá, 30-minute Lambda timeout, and more (November 24, 2026)

claims.claim: AWS Lambda 2014 yilinda 60 saniye zaman asimi suresiyle baslatildi, 2015'te 5 dakikaya ve 2018'de 15 dakikaya cikarildi.

evidence.quote: AWS Lambda launched in 2014 with a 60-second timeout, moved to 5 minutes in 2015 and to 15 minutes in 2018, and then stayed there for eight years.

claims.claim: AWS, Kolombiya'daki kullanicilara daha yakin olmak icin Bogota'da yeni bir Local Zone actigini duyurdu.

evidence.quote: A new AWS Local Zone in Bogotá brought AWS infrastructure closer to users in Colombia.
AWS Local Zone in Bogotá, Colombia – AWS opened a new Local Zone in Bogotá, so you can now run applications that need single-digit millisecond latency closer to users in Colombia.

claims.claim: AWS Lambda, istege bagli Event Function'lar icin zaman asimi sirasini 30 dakikaya (1800 saniye) cikardi.

evidence.quote: AWS Lambda now supports a 30-minute timeout for on-demand Event Functions – You can now configure any Event Function with a timeout of up to 30 minutes (1,800 seconds), double the previous limit

claims.claim: AWS Lambda, Lambda Managed Instances uzerindeki Event Function'lar icin GPU ornek destegi getirdi.

evidence.quote: AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances – You can now run GPU-accelerated inference, media processing, rendering, and scientific computing as Lambda functions

claims.claim: Amazon Polly, gonullu bir konusmacinin ses kayitlarindan ozel bir ses olusturmak icin ses klonlama destegi sundu.

evidence.quote: Amazon Polly now supports voice cloning – You can now create a custom voice in Amazon Polly from a few minutes of recordings of a consenting speaker, running on the Polly generative engine.

claims.claim: AWS STS, calisma zamaninda yetkileri daraltmak icin GetScopedCredentials ozelligini duyurdu.

evidence.quote: AWS STS announces GetScopedCredentials to scope down permissions at runtime – You can now take the temporary credentials a workload already holds and derive narrower ones, cutting permissions, session duration, or both.

claims.claim: Amazon Cognito, MCP istemcilerinin ve yapay zeka ajanlarinin calisma zamaninda kendilerini kaydetmesine olanak taniyan dinamik istemci kaydi destegi getirdi.

evidence.quote: Amazon Cognito now supports dynamic client registration – You can now let MCP clients and AI agents register themselves at runtime (RFC 7591) instead of creating an app client in advance for each one.

claims.claim: BMW Group, Ar-Ge biriminde 12.500'den fazla gelistiriciye sahip oldugunu belirtti.

evidence.quote: With more than 12,500 developers in R&D, BMW treats governance as deterministic code outside the agent’s reasoning loop
How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers – With more than 12,500 developers in R&D, BMW treats governance as deterministic code outside the agent’s reasoning loop
